welcome.headline: See Yourself in Our Sarees.
welcome.subhead: Step in front of the kiosk to experience authentic Kanchipuram and Banarasi pure silk sarees draped seamlessly on you.
welcome.privacy: Your privacy is guaranteed: camera checks run 100% locally in this kiosk display. No photo is processed or uploaded without your explicit consent.
welcome.touchToBegin: Touch the screen to begin your royal styling experience

permission.title: Camera Setup for Full-Body Dressing
permission.desc: To visualize sarees draped on your actual posture, the kiosk requires full-body camera access. Video is never streamed to any cloud server.
permission.deniedDesc: Camera permission was not granted. Please check system permissions or kiosk hardware connection.
permission.notFoundDesc: Please ensure the kiosk camera is securely connected to the USB port and power is on.
permission.fallbackNotice: For hardware testing or device without camera, you can switch to test customer mode.

positioning.title: Full-Body Framing & Posture Guide
positioning.instructions: Stand on the golden floor marker (~2.4m away) facing the screen with head and feet inside the frame.
positioning.autoCapture: Auto-capture triggers after 2 seconds of steady framing

guidance.noPerson: Please step in front of the kiosk camera.
guidance.multiPerson: Multiple people detected. Only one customer in frame please.
guidance.headCut: Please step back slightly — your head is cut off.
guidance.feetCut: Please step back — your feet are not fully visible.
guidance.offCenter: Please stand in the centre of the golden frame.
guidance.tooClose: You are too close. Please step back to the floor marker.
guidance.tooFar: You are too far. Please take a half-step forward.
guidance.lowLight: Lighting is dim. Please face the frontal illumination.

confirm.title: Review Your Capture
confirm.desc: Ensure your entire body from head to feet is clearly visible and posture is upright.
confirm.consentBody: By continuing, you consent to sending this single still image to our AI virtual try-on engine to generate your saree look. This image is strictly confidential, isolated to your session, and scheduled for immediate deletion upon session finish.
